slack_down_var.needle: model.slack_shared_es_soc_final_down = pe.Var(model.shared_energy_storages, model.scenarios_market, model.scenarios_operation, domain=pe.NonNegativeReals, initialize=0.0)

slack_reported_times_base.needle: slack_soc_final = pe.value(model.slack_shared_es_soc_final_up[e, s_m0, s_o0] - model.slack_shared_es_soc_final_down[e, s_m0, s_o0]) * s_base
